description: React component for sidebar category in a web application, managing categories and boards with UI interactions, onboarding tour steps, and deletion/renaming functionalities.

classes.name: SidebarCategory
classes.description: React functional component representing a sidebar category with boards, including UI controls, onboarding steps, and delete/rename functionalities.

methods.name: showBoard
methods.description: Navigates to the specified board and closes the sidebar if applicable.

methods.name: showView
methods.description: Navigates to a specific view within a board, updating the URL accordingly.

methods.name: isBoardVisible
methods.description: Determines if a board should be visible based on category metadata and user settings.

methods.name: handleCreateNewCategory
methods.description: Opens modal to create a new category.

methods.name: handleDeleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes the current category via mutator.

methods.name: handleUpdateCategory
methods.description: Opens modal to rename the category.

methods.name: onDeleteBoard
methods.description: Deletes a board, tracks telemetry, and navigates to the next available board.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates the category's collapsed state in the store.

methods.name: toggleCollapse
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of the category and updates the store.

methods.name: delayedSetBoardDraggingOver
methods.description: Sets dragging over state with a delay for UI feedback.
